user.title: New climate zone
user.description: Just enough to get going. Powers, prices and timings are set later from the options.

data.name: Zone name
data.power_sensor: Dedicated meter for the air conditioners

data_description.coupled: Units in other zones that share air with this one, for instance through an open door. Declaring them stops the zones fighting each other.
data_description.temp_sensor: If left empty, the temperature reported by the air conditioner is used.
data_description.power_sensor: Without it, power is estimated from the values declared in the options.
data_description.grid_sensor: Optional. Without it the zone does not follow the solar surplus and only handles doors and windows.

aperture.title: Doors and windows
aperture.description: For each air conditioner, pick the door and window sensors of its room. One opening is enough to stop it; leave empty a unit that must never stop.

data.resume_on_close: Restore on close as it was
data.resume_limit: Do not restore after an opening longer than

data_description.open_delay: Before stopping the unit. Walking through a door must not switch it off.
data_description.close_delay: Before restoring it. A window closed and reopened right away must not restart the compressor.
data_description.open_action: Fan only is used when the unit supports it; otherwise it is switched off.
data_description.resume_on_close: Only a unit that was on, and that was stopped by this integration, is restored — with its previous mode, temperature and fan.
data_description.resume_limit: Zero means always restore. Useful when leaving with a window open: the unit stays off when you come back.

soglie.title: Solar modulation
soglie.description: Thresholds: the units you switch on stay at the setpoint and fan you chose (comfort) and move to eco while importing from the grid. They are never switched on or off. Only a unit cooling with a setpoint below eco is touched.

data.import_threshold: Go to eco when importing more than
data.export_threshold: Back to comfort when exporting more than
data.comfort_extra_power: Extra consumption of each unit at comfort

data_description.eco_fan: The exact mode name, as the unit exposes it (for example Auto). Leave empty to leave the fan alone.
data_description.export_threshold: Comfort comes back with exactly the setpoint and fan that were there.
data_description.comfort_extra_power: Added to the export threshold: back at comfort the unit draws more, and without this margin it would trigger eco again by itself. Zero to disable.
data_description.active_to: Outside this slot nothing is touched. At the end of the slot, units in eco stay as they are.

abort.already_configured: A zone with this name already exists.

error.niente_da_fare: The zone must do at least one thing: set the grid sensor for solar modulation, or at least one door or window sensor.

data.power_sensor: Dedicated meter for the air conditioners

data_description.grid_sensor: Optional. Without it the zone does not follow the solar surplus and only handles doors and windows.

range.title: Temperatures and windows
range.description: Inside the charge window the control may go down to the minimum. Inside the comfort window it stops at the comfort minimum. Outside both it leaves everything alone.

data_description.temp_min: How far down it may push when there is surplus and the zone is empty.
data_description.charge_from: Leave both charge times empty if this zone should not be pre-cooled.

regolazione.title: Control and prices
regolazione.description: The two powers map surplus onto the setpoint: the watts drawn at each end of the range. They do not need to be exact.

data.use_fan: Use fan speed as the fast control

data_description.min_dwell: Below half an hour you chase noise on the grid meter rather than the temperature of the room.
data_description.fan_boost: The exact mode name as the unit exposes it. Leave empty to never push the fan.
data_description.manual_hold: Zero means until the following midnight.
